title: 第十一章 出关亮剑恩怨从此血来偿第十二章 暗流汹涌毒计藏锋逼生死
lines: 思过崖七日，罡风落幕，暮色收官。
连绵不绝、侵蚀入骨的崖顶狂风缓缓平息，漫天浮动的云雾向崖底沉降，整片狭小孤寂的崖顶平台终于恢复安宁。落日余晖穿透云层，洒落在少年挺拔清瘦的身躯之上，镀上一层冰冷的金边。
七日禁足，旁人视作惩戒折磨，于沈砚而言，却是一场彻彻底底的涅槃淬炼。
无人知晓，这七日罡风洗身、孤寂炼心、绝境磨骨，究竟让他蜕变到了何等恐怖的地步。
此刻的沈砚，静静伫立崖边，青布武服依旧朴素无华，甚至边角沾染着崖顶的尘土，看似狼狈普通，可周身气质早已天翻地覆。
七日前，他锋芒外露、锐气逼人，杀伐藏于眼底，爱恨显于言行。
七日后，他敛尽所有戾气、藏尽所有锋芒，外表平和沉静、淡漠如水，仿佛褪去所有棱角，如同最普通的侯府旁支子弟。
可唯有他自己清楚，内里筋骨气血、武道道心，早已淬炼至纯粹极致，无半分虚浮、无半分软肋。
淬体六重圆满，根基凝实无瑕，肉身历经罡风日夜打磨，坚韧、爆发力、抗打击能力，尽数碾压同阶，无限逼近淬体七重壁垒。寻常淬体七重武者，正面搏杀，不堪一击。即便是此前碾压他的淬体八重死士再来一轮，他亦可从容反杀、强势破局。
更可怕的是心境蜕变。
温柔散尽，慈悲封藏，心中再无半分妇人之仁，再无半分隐忍退让。
遇善可容，遇恶必斩，人不犯我我不犯人，人若犯我斩草除根。
这便是他如今的道。
“沈砚，禁足期满，速速下崖归府，等候后续安排。”
崖口处，两名值守护卫面无表情开口，语气刻板依旧，只是眼底深处，再也没了此前的轻视与漠然，取而代之的是深深的忌惮与谨慎。
七日之前，那群三房附庸子弟落荒而逃的模样，他们历历在目。
身陷枷锁、身处绝境，依旧能震慑众人、压住风波，这般心性魄力，绝非寻常少年所有。
沈砚闻言，微微颔首，没有多余言语。
他缓步抬步，动作不疾不徐，每一步落下，脚掌稳稳贴合崖石，身形平稳如山，没有半分禁足七日的虚弱憔悴。常人被困思过崖七日，禁修禁运、罡风蚀体，必然气血衰败、筋骨酸软、心神萎靡。
可沈砚，不仅毫无损耗，反倒愈发凝练、愈发厚重。
他一路前行，背影孤挺、沉稳冷冽，沿着山道石阶，一步步离开后山绝境，朝着侯府核心区域走去。
山道两侧，林木葱郁、晚风微凉，往来不少侯府子弟、杂役护卫。
所有人看到沈砚的瞬间，动作皆是一顿，目光齐刷刷锁定在他身上，眼底满是惊疑、好奇、戏谑、复杂的神色。
整个镇北侯府，无人不知无人不晓，七日之前，这位落魄旁支少年，硬撼三房、顶撞族老、重伤沈浩、手握死士铁证，最终却依旧被宗族偏袒定罪，打入思过崖禁足受罚。
所有人都默认，七日思过崖苦寒折磨，足以磨碎他的傲骨、耗尽他的锐气、崩坏他的心境，此刻出关，必然是萎靡颓废、心态崩塌、锐气尽失。
可亲眼所见，众人心中预想的画面尽数落空。
沈砚依旧脊背挺直、眼神澄澈、步履沉稳，没有半分落魄狼狈，没有半分颓废怨怼，只是周身气场愈发冰冷深沉，让人不敢轻易靠近、不敢随意打量。
“他居然一点事都没有？”
“思过崖七日罡风侵蚀，怎么可能状态这么好？怕是硬撑面子罢了。”
“再撑又如何？得罪三房、忤逆宗族，从此在侯府再无立足之地，这辈子也就这样了。”
细碎的窃窃私语此起彼伏，充斥着轻视、嘲讽、看热闹的心态。
沈砚充耳不闻，目不斜视，心中毫无波澜。
蝼蚁的聒噪，不值得他浪费半分心神。今日出关，不为辩解、不为证明、不为博取任何人的认可，只为清算旧账、踏平阻碍、杀出前路。
一路前行，直通演武场。
按照侯府规矩，禁足期满子弟，需第一时间回归演武堂归队操练，接受执事核查状态，听从后续安排。
此刻，恰逢傍晚操练收尾之时。
整片演武场人头攒动，所有同辈子弟尽数在场，三房嫡系、附庸派系、中立子弟齐聚一堂，气氛热闹，却也暗流涌动。
高台之上，执事赵坤端坐原位，面色阴沉，目光阴冷，早早便听闻沈砚出关的消息，此刻死死盯着入场的少年，眼底杀意暗藏。
content_en:
After thinking about crossing the cliff for seven days, the strong wind came to an end and the twilight came to an end.
The continuous and eroding winds on the cliff top slowly subsided, the clouds and mist floating in the sky settled towards the bottom of the cliff, and the entire small and lonely cliff top platform finally returned to peace. The afterglow of the setting sun penetrated the clouds and fell on the young man's tall and thin body, coating it with a layer of cold gold.
Being grounded for seven days may be regarded as punishment and torture by others, but for Shen Yan, it is a complete Nirvana tempering.
No one knows how terrifyingly these seven days of strong wind washing his body, solitude training his mind, and desperate situation grinding his bones have transformed him to such a terrifying degree.
At this moment, Shen Yan was standing quietly on the edge of the cliff. His green cloth military uniform was still simple and unpretentious, and even the corners were stained with the dust from the cliff top. He looked ordinary and embarrassed, but his overall temperament had already been turned upside down.
Seven days ago, his sharp edge was exposed, his vigor was overwhelming, his killing power was hidden in his eyes, and his love and hate were revealed in his words and deeds.
Seven days later, he had suppressed all his anger and hidden all his sharpness. His appearance was as calm and indifferent as water, as if all the edges and corners had faded away, just like the most ordinary disciple of the Marquis's branch.
But only he himself knew that the muscles, bones, qi, blood, and martial arts heart inside had been tempered to the purest extreme, without any emptiness or weakness.
The sixth level of body quenching is perfect, the foundation is solid and flawless, and the physical body has been polished by the strong wind day and night. Its tenacity, explosive power, and ability to resist blows can crush the same level, infinitely approaching the seventh level barrier of body quenching. An ordinary seventh-level body-tempering warrior is vulnerable to a single blow in a head-on fight. Even if the eighth-level body-tempered dead warrior who crushed him before comes back for another round, he can calmly counterattack and break the situation with force.
Even more frightening is the change in mood.
The gentleness is gone, the compassion is sealed, and there is no more womanly kindness in my heart, no more forbearance and concession.
I will tolerate good deeds, but I will kill them when they do bad ones. I will not offend others unless they offend me, but if they do offend me, I will cut them off and root them out.
This is his way now.
"Shen Yan, the period of confinement is over, please hurry down the cliff and return home, waiting for follow-up arrangements."
At the edge of the cliff, the two guards on duty spoke expressionlessly, with the same rigid tone, but deep in their eyes, the previous contempt and indifference were no longer there, replaced by deep fear and caution.
Seven days ago, they could still remember how the group of three-room vassal disciples fled.
Even though he is in shackles and in a desperate situation, he can still intimidate everyone and suppress the storm. This kind of mental courage is definitely not something ordinary young people can possess.
When Shen Yan heard this, he nodded slightly and had no extra words.
He raised his steps slowly, neither fast nor slow. Every time he took a step, his soles were firmly attached to the cliff. His body was as stable as a mountain, and he did not feel weak and haggard after being grounded for seven days. Ordinary people are trapped and thought about crossing a cliff for seven days. They are forbidden to practice and practice, and the strong winds corrode the body. They will inevitably have a decline in Qi and blood, weak muscles and bones, and a depressed mind.
But when the inkstone is sunk, not only is there no loss, but it becomes more condensed and thicker.
He walked forward with his back straight, calm and cold, along the stone steps of the mountain road, leaving the desperate situation in the back mountain step by step, and walked towards the core area of ​​​​the Hou Mansion.
On both sides of the mountain road, there are lush trees and a cool evening breeze. There are many children of the Hou family and guardsmen coming and going.
The moment everyone saw Shen Yan, their movements stopped and their eyes were all fixed on him, their eyes full of surprise, curiosity, teasing, and complicated expressions.
No one in the entire Zhenbei Hou Mansion knew that seven days ago, this down-and-out young man from a side branch had beaten the third family member, contradicted the clan elder, seriously injured Shen Hao, and had irrefutable evidence of death. In the end, he was still favored by the clan and convicted, and was imprisoned and punished at Siguo Cliff.
Everyone agreed that seven days of thinking about it, suffering from the bitter cold, was enough to grind his pride, exhaust his vigor, and destroy his state of mind. When he came out of seclusion, he would definitely be depressed and decadent, his mentality collapsed, and his vigor was completely lost.
But what I saw with my own eyes was that all the images that everyone had imagined came to nothing.
Shen Yan's back is still straight, his eyes are clear, and his steps are steady. He is not a bit embarrassed, not a bit decadent and resentful, but the aura around him is getting colder and deeper, making people dare not approach easily or look at him casually.
"He's actually fine with nothing?"
"How can it be possible that Siguoya is in such good condition after being corroded by the strong wind for seven days? I'm afraid it's just trying to save face."
"So what if I hold on any longer? If I offend the Third Fang and disobey the clan, I will no longer have a foothold in the Marquis Mansion. This will be the case for the rest of my life."
Tiny whispers came and went, full of contempt, ridicule, and a spectator mentality.
Shen Yan turned a deaf ear, didn't squint his eyes, and had no disturbance in his heart.
The noise of the ants was not worth wasting half of his attention. I left the country today not to defend, prove, or win anyone’s approval, but to settle old scores, clear obstacles, and find a way forward.
Go forward all the way and go straight to the martial arts arena.
According to the rules of the Marquis Mansion, children who have expired the confinement period must return to the martial arts hall to join the team for training as soon as possible, accept the status verification by the deacon, and follow the follow-up arrangements.
This moment coincides with the end of evening practice.
The entire martial arts arena was crowded, and all the disciples of the same generation were present. The direct descendants of the three families, the vassal factions, and the neutral disciples gathered together. The atmosphere was lively, but there was also an undercurrent.
On the high platform, Deacon Zhao Kun was sitting in his original position, with a gloomy face and cold eyes. He had heard the news of Shen Yan's release early on, and now he was staring at the young man entering the room with murderous intent hidden in his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 11: The grudges will be paid with blood after leaving the seclusion. Chapter 12: Undercurrents and poisonous schemes threaten life and death.
